prompt: Subject: A Paris summer wearing paper scraps. Main Subject: A scrapbook-style real-life collage featuring a woman in her 20s walking on a sunny Paris street corner, placed large in the center, with only the figure cut out with the outline of off-white torn paper. Depicts white summer clothes, a red cafe awning, and old paper notes floating around as a single integrated image. Figure/Expression: Slender oval face, almond-shaped brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, small nose, pale coral lips. Face tilted slightly to the left, looking slightly above the camera with a calm expression and lips slightly open. Dark brown hair loosely tied low, with thin bangs near the center and thin wisps falling on the cheeks. Small gold earrings. Clothing/Pose: Off-white ribbed camisole top. Thin shoulder straps, thin lace edging at the bust, small white buttons lined up vertically. Lightweight long skirt with a light blue floral pattern on a white background, thin drawstring at the center waist. Walking facing forward, arms down naturally, holding a bag with a brown leather handle in the left hand. The wind blows the skirt hem to the right. Background/Light: A black streetlight on the left, white Haussmann-style buildings, a bicycle and a car on the roadside. A cafe with rattan chairs and round tables on the right, 'CAFÉ DE FLORE' in white letters on a red awning. The upper part is a blue sky and large white clouds. Strong direct summer sunlight from the upper left illuminates the hair, shoulders, and edges of the clothes, casting hard, short shadows on the road. Leaves a non-uniform off-white torn paper edge around the figure's outer perimeter. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. A wide-angle snap from a front camera slightly lower than eye level, capturing from the sky overhead to around the thighs. The figure is large in the center, the face in the upper half, and the depth of the cityscape extends to the left and right. The skirt and arms are cut at the bottom. Focus on the face and clothes, with a medium depth of field so the location is identifiable. Texture/Style: Handmade scrapbook-style collage based on photorealistic real-life photos. Place a piece of graph paper 'mon été à Paris ♡' in the center left, old paper 'PARIS' 'mon amour' and a botanical illustration in the top right, layered paper 'FLEUR DE RÊVE' in the center right, and a blue-green paper scrap 'L'ÂME LÉGÈRE' in the bottom left. Finely depict paper fibers, torn white edges, dried flowers and tape, cloth weaves, and grains of sunlight. Negative: Omission of torn paper collage and red cafe awning, substitution of text.
